package sources

import (
    "net/http"
    "net/http/httptest"
    "testing"
)

func TestHostedOpenWrtStableBeforeReleaseCandidate(t *testing.T) {
    server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        _, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<a>25.12.0</a><a>25.12.0-rc1</a>`))
    }))
    defer server.Close()
    source := &openwrt{}
    source.client = server.Client()
    release, err := source.getLatestServiceRelease(server.URL, "25.12")
    if err != nil || release != "25.12.0" { t.Fatalf("unstable or missing vendor release: %s %v", release, err) }
}
